dynamic_line: "Keep your voice down. I hid here when the Count remade the others. I can show you where he waits, but I will not go back down there."

responses.text: Why is the family room untouched?
He is dead. What about the opening below?
Stay here. I will look around.

dynamic_line: "The stairs are in the northeastern execution hall. Cross the open yard, approach through the kitchen and offices, or use the break in the western wall. The clerk's key opens a short barred passage, but you do not need it. Below, the exposed seam is in a separate northern alcove; leave space around the pillars during the fight."
"They were people. He forced his own flesh into them. There are only a few left here. Kill them separately if you must; they will not return, and he cannot call an endless army."

"The exposed stone at the north end feeds this place. Examine it now that he cannot hold it open. It should quiet new incursions nearby. It will not undo your Brand or kill the things already outside."
"That is Theresia's room. He kept it free of what he did to the rest of us. It tells you something about him; it does not erase the execution lists. I do not know where she is now."
